name: Crimson & Gold
description: The look built around the artwork: near-black warm surfaces, crimson accents and a gold dice highlight, matched to the shaded die and the medallion hero points. Does not follow the operating system's light/dark setting.
_note: Only what differs from Classic is listed. Unlike Slate Dark's cool greys, every surface here is warmed towards the artwork's own deep reds, so the medallion's black outline reads as a drawn line rather than as a hole in the page. The accent and the dice highlight are taken straight off the medallion: its crimson body (#ba1500) lifted until it clears the contrast floor as text, and the gold of its centre.

colors._badges: Warmed off Classic's cooler set so a chip sits on the card rather than on top of it; the alternate-effect gold deliberately echoes accent.dice.

_metrics: Slate Dark's softer corners and roomier padding — the artwork is round and heavily outlined, and square edges beside it read as a mismatch.
_assets: The whole point of this preset: the shaded die and the medallion pips, which is where every colour above came from.
